newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to register CANTV shares in US -paper.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to register CANTV shares in US -paper.

text.p: Venezuela will register telephone company CANTV's shares with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday for their possible sale in U.S. markets later this year, leading daily El Nacional reported.
Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) President Alberto Poletto said SEC approval would take between four and five weeks.

The selloff, scheduled for November, will see 10 percent of the company placed on Venezuelan markets, nine percent transferred to workers and the remaining 30 percent placed in a global share offering led by investment banks Lehman Brothers and SBC Warburg.
The government sold part of CANTV in 1991, when VenWorld, a consortium led by GTE Corp, bought a 40 percent stake and employees bought 11 percent of the company.
